resources.string: Three steps for a more complete Home experience. Your layout stays unchanged.
Choose MiDuo in the system Home app settings.
For Back, Home, Recents and notification gestures. Does not read screen content.
Requires MiDuo as Home and accessibility. Try system gesture settings first; some phones need additional system authorization.
Check Back, Home and Recents on your phone. Hiding the navigation bar alone does not mean gestures work.
Choose the original launcher in system settings. MiDuo layout is kept.
Open Home settings and choose your system launcher. This does not uninstall MiDuo or erase your layout. If gestures do not work, first restore navigation buttons.
Review the backup before applying it. Widget providers may require setup again.
Long-press empty space to edit Home. Swipe between pages. Hold a widget near an edge to change pages; on the widgets page, hold near the top or bottom to scroll.
System settings are unavailable on this device.
